paper: Mukherjee & Zhu (2011) Reduced rank ridge regression and its kernel extensions, SADM

gap_relative_to_claim: method only, simulations, no proportional limits
relevance: not a threat; source of estimator

paper: Degras et al. (2024) On the stability of reduced-rank ridge regression, EUSIPCO
what_it_covers: simulation study of out-of-sample R2 vs p/n
relevance: empirical relative; supports p/n scaling intuition

paper: Ding & Yang (2021) Spiked separable covariance matrices and principal components, AoS 49(2)

gap_relative_to_claim: does not treat signal+separable-noise with spike vector tied to noise eigenbasis through a hat matrix; machinery would give it
